response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff Software Engineer with excellent mentoring skills and a strong background in software craftsmanship, TDD, and full-stack development. However, he is not a fit for this specific role because he lacks the strictly required 8 years of C++ programming experience, having only about 7 months of professional C++ exposure. Additionally, his background is heavily focused on product engineering and web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than the low-level, large-scale cloud compute infrastructure and hardware architecture required for this position.
strengths: Over 15 years of software engineering experience with a strong dedication to software craftsmanship, TDD, and CI/CD best practices.
Proven technical leadership and mentoring capabilities, demonstrated through Staff-level roles, organizing coding dojos, and conducting tech workshops.
Strong architectural skills and ability to own ambiguous projects, highlighted by his founding and development of the GISCollective platform.
concerns: Falls significantly short of the minimum 8 years of C++ experience, showing less than one year of professional C++ work on his resume.
Core expertise lies in full-stack web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than cloud compute platform infrastructure.
Lacks deep, large-scale hardware architecture, storage, or low-level networking experience required for the role.
